guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 由細節類別、應力範圍與斷裂力學判斷鋼橋裂縫的風險，選擇止裂孔、錘擊或拼接補強並訂定追蹤週期。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Judging steel-bridge crack risk from detail category, stress range and fracture mechanics, then choosing arrest holes, peening or splices and setting follow-up intervals. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: FHWA 修復手冊估計變形誘發的開裂佔全部疲勞裂縫的 90% 以上
明尼蘇達州約 85% 的鋼橋建於 1986 年以前，多數可能帶有腹板間隙細節
FHWA 手冊要求止裂孔最小孔徑 1.0 in（25.4 mm），現場經驗支持 2 至 4 in（50.8 至 101.6 mm）
邊緣裂縫的止裂孔計算孔徑應加大 25%
氣動錘擊約 40 psi、最多 6 道，目標塑性深度 0.8 至 1.6 mm，可處理約 3 mm 深的表面裂縫
AASHTO E′ 類常幅疲勞門檻 2.6 ksi（約 18 MPa），E 類 4.5 ksi（約 31 MPa）
美國國家橋梁檢查標準要求斷裂關鍵構件至少每 24 個月做近距離檢查
I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋主跨約 900 ft（274 m），1973 年通車，2021 年 5 月 11 日發現繫梁斷裂，8 月 2 日全面恢復通車
Hoan 橋 2000 年 12 月斷裂後北行車道下陷約 4 ft（約 1.2 m）
factsEn: The FHWA repair manual estimates that distortion-induced cracking causes over 90% of all fatigue cracking
About 85% of Minnesota's steel bridges were built before 1986 and may carry web-gap details
The FHWA manual requires arrest holes of at least 1.0 in (25.4 mm), with field experience supporting 2 to 4 in (50.8 to 101.6 mm)
The calculated arrest-hole diameter for an edge crack should be increased by 25%
Air-hammer peening uses about 40 psi and up to 6 passes for a plastic depth of 0.8 to 1.6 mm, treating surface cracks up to about 3 mm deep
The AASHTO constant-amplitude fatigue threshold is 2.6 ksi (about 18 MPa) for Category E′ and 4.5 ksi (about 31 MPa) for Category E
The US National Bridge Inspection Standards require hands-on inspection of fracture-critical members at least every 24 months
The I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge has a main span of about 900 ft (274 m), opened in 1973, had a tie-girder fracture found on 11 May 2021 and fully reopened on 2 August 2021
After its December 2000 fracture, the Hoan Bridge's northbound lanes sagged about 4 ft (about 1.2 m)
timeline: 1967　Silver Bridge 因無冗餘眼桿脆斷倒塌，促成斷裂關鍵構件的檢查與韌性要求
1970　加州 Bryte Bend 橋在施工中斷裂，低韌性 A514 鋼與既有焊趾裂縫是主因
2000　密爾瓦基 Hoan 橋三根主梁中兩根在沒有疲勞裂縫下脆性斷裂
2005–2013　明尼蘇達大學完成、FHWA 發布鋼橋疲勞裂縫修復與補強手冊 FHWA-IF-13-020
2021　I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋發現繫梁斷裂，緊急加板補強後於 8 月恢復通車
timelineEn: 1967 — The Silver Bridge collapses through brittle fracture of a non-redundant eyebar, prompting inspection and toughness rules for fracture-critical members
1970 — California's Bryte Bend Bridge fractures during construction, traced to low-toughness A514 steel and a pre-existing weld-toe crack
2000 — Two of the three girders of Milwaukee's Hoan Bridge fracture in a brittle way without prior fatigue cracking
2005–2013 — The University of Minnesota completes, and FHWA issues, manual FHWA-IF-13-020 on repairing and retrofitting fatigue cracks in steel bridges
2021 — A tie-girder fracture is found on the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge; after emergency plating repairs it reopens in August

I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge, Memphis
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair
guides.concept: 從焊接細節的應力範圍與 AASHTO 疲勞類別出發，區分載重誘發與變形誘發的疲勞裂縫，以斷裂韌性與 Paris 定律估算臨界尺寸與剩餘壽命，再處理止裂孔、錘擊、螺栓拼接、非破壞檢測、現場應變量測與斷裂關鍵構件的檢查交接，並以 Yellow Mill Pond、Lafayette Street、Hoan 與 I-40 Hernando de Soto 等橋為實例。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from stress ranges at welded details and the AASHTO fatigue categories, distinguish load-induced from distortion-induced cracking, estimate critical size and remaining life with fracture toughness and the Paris law, then cover arrest holes, peening, bolted splices, nondestructive testing, field strain measurement and the inspection and handover of fracture-critical members, using the Yellow Mill Pond, Lafayette Street, Hoan and I-40 Hernando de Soto bridges as examples.
procedure: 鋼橋的疲勞裂縫幾乎都從焊接細節開始：焊趾的幾何不連續、殘餘拉應力與微小熔渣缺陷使局部應力集中，車輛每次通過造成的應力範圍（而不是最大應力）驅動裂縫逐步成長。AASHTO 把細節依疲勞強度分成 A 到 E′ 等類別，蓋板端部的橫向填角焊屬最差的 E 或 E′ 類，康乃狄克州 I-95 Yellow Mill Pond 橋的蓋板端部裂縫就是 FHWA 修復手冊中的典型照片。由於 S–N 曲線斜率為 3，應力範圍增加約 26% 壽命就減半，因此疲勞評估的核心是準確的應力範圍與循環次數。
主梁間的橫隔或橫構架在活載下使相鄰主梁產生不同撓度，若橫構架連接板沒有與受拉翼板相連，連接板端部與翼板之間的一小段腹板（腹板間隙）就被迫承受面外變形。這段腹板很短，極小的相對位移就產生很大的二次彎曲應力，形成平行於焊道的裂縫。FHWA 手冊估計變形誘發的開裂佔全部疲勞裂縫的 90% 以上，1985 年以前的設計普遍有此細節，例如明尼蘇達州約 85% 的鋼橋建於 1986 年以前。

疲勞裂縫本身不會讓橋倒塌，真正的危險是裂縫長到臨界尺寸後在低溫下脆性斷裂。臨界尺寸由材料韌性、應力大小與幾何拘束決定；1967 年 Silver Bridge 因無冗餘眼桿脆斷而倒塌，促成 1970 年代的斷裂控制計畫與 Charpy V 型缺口韌性要求。2000 年 12 月密爾瓦基 Hoan 橋三根主梁中有兩根斷裂，FHWA 手冊指出這是在沒有先前疲勞裂縫下發生的脆性斷裂；焊接板件交會形成的高拘束使鋼材無法藉降伏釋放應力，冬季低溫又降低了韌性。
裂縫一旦存在，S–N 曲線就不再適用，需改用線彈性斷裂力學：每次循環的成長量 da/dN 與應力強度因子範圍 ΔK 的冪次成正比（Paris 定律），而 ΔK 又隨裂縫長度增加，所以裂縫越長長得越快，壽命大部分消耗在裂縫很短的階段。剩餘壽命取決於目前尺寸、臨界尺寸與應力範圍，這也說明及早找到短裂縫的價值遠大於事後補強。
止裂孔是在裂尖鑽一個圓孔，把尖銳裂尖換成有限半徑的缺口，使局部應力集中降到不足以重新起裂。FHWA 手冊稱鑽孔可能是最常用的疲勞裂縫修復法，要求最小孔徑 1.0 in（25.4 mm），邊緣裂縫的計算孔徑要加大 25%，現場經驗支持 2 至 4 in 的孔徑；孔要以環形鑽施作，嚴禁火焰切割，孔緣須磨平去毛邊。孔必須真正包含裂尖，否則裂縫會從孔外繼續成長。

錘擊處理以氣動鎚沿焊趾敲擊，使表層塑性變形並引入壓縮殘餘應力，同時修圓焊趾幾何；FHWA 手冊指出它通常可把疲勞抗力提高至少一個細節類別，並可處理深約 3 mm 以內的表面裂縫。裂縫已貫穿翼板或腹板時，就要以螺栓拼接板跨越裂縫，讓力量繞過斷裂斷面；高強度鋼更偏好螺栓補強，以免焊接造成氫致開裂。2021 年 I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋繫梁斷裂後，也是先在兩側加鋼板穩住構件，再加板繞過斷裂部位並切除較小的受損段。
目視只能找到已經使油漆開裂的裂縫，確認長度與裂尖位置要靠非破壞檢測。FHWA 手冊說明染色滲透與磁粉是最簡便常用的方法：染色滲透以三種藥劑讓顯像劑把滲入裂縫的染料吸出；磁粉可找到表面及部分近表面裂縫，但隔著油漆並不可靠。量測裂縫深度需要超音波或繞射時差法（TOFD），設備與人員資格要求都較高。檢測前必須去除油漆與鏽皮，檢測後再補塗防蝕。
設計用的疲勞卡車與實際交通差異很大，評估既有橋最可靠的做法是在疲勞敏感細節附近貼應變計，連續記錄一到數週的實際交通反應。以雨流計數法把不規則的應變歷時拆成一個個循環，再依 Miner 線性累積損傷把不同大小的循環換算成一個等效常幅應力範圍。量測也能找出模型沒有考慮的效應，例如變形誘發的二次彎曲或支承卡死造成的額外應力。
修復不是終點：止裂孔可能重新起裂、拼接板邊緣成為新的起點，未修的同類細節也可能陸續出現裂縫。FHWA 手冊指出，對常見的冗餘橋梁，最好的選擇常常不是修復而是監測裂縫，面外變形造成的裂縫尤其如此。檢查間隔應由可偵測的最小裂縫、臨界裂縫與成長速率決定，而不只是套用固定的兩年週期；偵測能力越差，所需的檢查頻率就越高。
斷裂關鍵構件是受拉、一旦斷裂可能造成部分或整座橋倒塌的鋼構件，美國國家橋梁檢查標準要求至少每 24 個月做一次可以用手觸及的近距離檢查，且不適用 48 個月的延長週期。交接檔案要讓下一個檢查團隊知道每一個構件在哪裡、屬哪一類細節、曾有哪些裂縫、怎麼修、修後量到什麼。把這些資料連成時間序列，就能從裂縫成長反推實際應力範圍，判斷修復是否有效。
procedureEn: Fatigue cracks in steel bridges almost always start at welded details: the geometric discontinuity at the weld toe, tensile residual stress and tiny slag defects concentrate stress locally, and the stress range from each passing vehicle, not the peak stress, drives the crack forward. AASHTO groups details by fatigue strength into categories A to E′; transverse fillet welds at cover-plate ends are among the worst, Category E or E′, and the cracked cover-plate end on the I-95 Yellow Mill Pond Bridge in Connecticut is a classic illustration in the FHWA repair manual. Because the S–N curve has a slope of 3, a stress range about 26% higher halves the life, so fatigue assessment hinges on accurate stress ranges and cycle counts.

Under live load, diaphragms or cross-frames between girders force adjacent girders to deflect differently; if the cross-frame connection plate is not attached to the tension flange, the short strip of web between the plate end and the flange, the web gap, must absorb out-of-plane distortion. Because the strip is so short, a tiny relative displacement produces large secondary bending stress and cracks parallel to the weld. The FHWA manual estimates that distortion-induced cracking causes over 90% of all fatigue cracking, and the detail was common in designs before 1985; in Minnesota, for example, about 85% of steel bridges were built before 1986.

A fatigue crack alone does not drop a bridge; the real danger is that once it reaches critical size it can fracture in a brittle way at low temperature. Critical size depends on toughness, stress level and geometric constraint. The 1967 collapse of the Silver Bridge through brittle fracture of a non-redundant eyebar led to the fracture control plan and Charpy V-notch toughness requirements of the 1970s. In December 2000 two of the three girders of Milwaukee's Hoan Bridge fractured; the FHWA manual describes it as brittle fracture without prior fatigue cracking, where highly constrained intersecting welded plates prevented the steel from relieving stress by yielding and winter cold reduced its toughness.

Once a crack exists the S–N curve no longer applies and linear-elastic fracture mechanics takes over: growth per cycle, da/dN, is proportional to a power of the stress-intensity range ΔK (the Paris law), and ΔK itself rises with crack length, so longer cracks grow faster and most of the life is spent while the crack is still short. Remaining life depends on current size, critical size and stress range, which is why finding short cracks early is worth far more than strengthening afterwards.

An arrest hole drilled at the crack tip replaces the sharp tip with a notch of finite radius, lowering the local stress concentration below what is needed to re-initiate cracking. The FHWA manual calls hole drilling perhaps the most widely used fatigue-crack repair, requires a minimum diameter of 1.0 in (25.4 mm), increases the calculated diameter by 25% for edge cracks, and notes that field experience supports holes of 2 to 4 in; holes are cut with annular cutters, never flame-cut, and their edges ground smooth. The hole must truly contain the crack tip, or the crack simply continues outside it.

Peening hammers the weld toe with a pneumatic tool, plastically deforming the surface, introducing compressive residual stress and rounding the toe; the FHWA manual says it generally raises fatigue resistance by at least one detail category and can treat surface cracks up to about 3 mm deep. Once a crack has passed through a flange or web, bolted splice plates must bridge it so force bypasses the broken section, and bolting is preferred on high-strength steel to avoid hydrogen cracking from welding. After the 2021 tie-girder fracture on the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge, plates were first added on both sides to stabilise the member, then more plating bypassed the fracture and a smaller damaged piece was removed.

Visual inspection finds only cracks that have already split the paint; confirming length and tip location needs nondestructive testing. The FHWA manual describes dye penetrant and magnetic particle testing as the easiest and most widely used: penetrant is a three-part system whose developer draws dye back out of the crack, while magnetic particle testing finds surface and some near-surface cracks but is unreliable through paint. Sizing crack depth needs ultrasonic testing or time-of-flight diffraction (TOFD), with costlier equipment and more highly trained operators. Paint and mill scale must be removed before testing and the coating restored afterwards.

The design fatigue truck differs greatly from real traffic, so the most reliable assessment of an existing bridge puts strain gauges near fatigue-sensitive details and records actual traffic for one to several weeks. Rainflow counting splits the irregular strain history into individual cycles, and Miner's linear damage rule converts cycles of different sizes into one equivalent constant-amplitude stress range. Measurements also reveal effects the model omits, such as distortion-induced secondary bending or extra stress from seized bearings.

Repair is not the end: arrest holes can re-initiate, splice-plate edges can become new origins, and unrepaired details of the same type may crack in turn. The FHWA manual notes that for common redundant bridges the best choice is often to monitor rather than repair a crack, especially one caused by out-of-plane distortion. Inspection intervals should follow from the smallest detectable crack, the critical crack and the growth rate, not just a fixed two-year cycle; the poorer the detection capability, the more often one must inspect.

Fracture-critical members are steel members in tension whose failure would probably collapse part or all of the bridge; the US National Bridge Inspection Standards require hands-on inspection at least every 24 months and exclude them from the 48-month extended cycle. The handover file must tell the next inspection team where each member is, what detail category it belongs to, which cracks it has had, how they were repaired and what was measured afterwards. Linked as a time series, these data let engineers back-calculate the real stress range from crack growth and judge whether a repair worked.
evidence: 新建設計避免使用 E 與 E′ 類細節；既有橋的疲勞清冊要依細節類別與應力範圍排序檢查優先順序，並把每一個 E′ 類細節的位置標在檢查圖上，作為每次例行檢查必看的點。
修復腹板間隙要先決定策略：加勁（以螺栓角鋼或 T 型鋼把連接板接到翼板）或軟化（放大間隙、移除或移位橫構架），不可兩者混用；任何修復都要先量測再設計，修復後再量一次確認應力確實下降。
斷裂關鍵構件的修復焊接必須依 AASHTO/AWS D1.5 的斷裂控制計畫執行，包括銲材、預熱、韌性試驗與更嚴格的非破壞檢測；設計審查要特別找出零間隙相交的板件，改為留設間隙或螺栓連接。
每一條已知裂縫都要有編號、量測方法、量測日期與照片，報告中附上依斷裂力學估算的剩餘壽命與下次檢查日期；初始尺寸、應力範圍與韌性等假設必須寫明，讓下一位工程師可以更新計算。
止裂孔是局部或暫時措施，報告須說明裂縫成因是否已處理；變形誘發裂縫在鑽孔後通常還要搭配腹板間隙加勁或軟化。孔內可依 FHWA 建議裝上全預拉的高強度螺栓與硬化墊圈，使孔周保持有利的壓應力。
evidenceEn: Avoid Category E and E′ details in new design; for existing bridges, rank the fatigue inventory by detail category and stress range to set inspection priority, and mark every Category E′ detail on the inspection drawings as a must-see point at each routine inspection.

Choose the web-gap strategy first: stiffening (bolting the connection plate to the flange with angles or a tee) or softening (enlarging the gap, removing or repositioning the cross-frame), never a mix; measure before designing any repair and measure again afterwards to confirm the stress has actually dropped.

Repair welding on fracture-critical members must follow the fracture control plan of AASHTO/AWS D1.5, covering consumables, preheat, toughness testing and stricter nondestructive testing; design review should hunt for plates intersecting with zero gap and change them to gapped or bolted connections.

Give every known crack a number, measurement method, date and photograph, and attach to the report a fracture-mechanics estimate of remaining life and the next inspection date; state the assumptions on initial size, stress range and toughness so the next engineer can update the calculation.

An arrest hole is a local or temporary measure, and the report must say whether the cause has been addressed; distortion-induced cracks usually also need web-gap stiffening or softening after drilling. As the FHWA manual suggests, a fully pretensioned high-strength bolt with hardened washers can be installed in the hole to keep favourable compression around it.
pitfalls: 蓋板端部的焊趾裂縫先在翼板內穿透厚度，再沿翼板寬度擴展；若未及時發現，裂縫可貫穿整個受拉翼板並進入腹板，FHWA 手冊收錄的明尼蘇達州聖保羅 Lafayette Street 橋就出現貫穿整個梁深的疲勞裂縫。
Hoan 橋斷裂後北行車道下陷約 4 ft（約 1.2 m），雖無人受傷，但大橋封閉，受損段以控制爆破移除，修復與補強歷時近一年；高拘束細節即使沒有疲勞裂縫，也可能在寒冬中瞬間斷裂。
若孔位偏離裂尖，或裂縫在背面比正面更長，止裂孔只是在裂縫旁邊多開了一個洞；以火焰切割開孔會在孔壁留下硬化層與缺口，反而成為新的疲勞起點。
隔著油漆做磁粉檢測，或去漆後未清除鏽皮，容易漏判短裂縫；把焊道表面的咬邊或研磨痕誤判為裂縫，則會導致不必要的鑽孔與補強，反而增加新的應力集中。
2021 年 I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋繫梁斷裂被發現後，業餘照片顯示同一位置早在 2016 年就有損傷，2019 年的空拍檢查影像也拍到裂縫；調查認為斷裂源於製造時焊接修補引發的氫致裂紋而非疲勞成長，但它說明若未真正近距離檢視，任何追蹤計畫都會落空。
pitfallsEn: A weld-toe crack at a cover-plate end first grows through the flange thickness and then across its width; if missed, it can sever the whole tension flange and run into the web, as in the full-girder-depth fatigue crack of the Lafayette Street Bridge in St. Paul, Minnesota, shown in the FHWA manual.

After the Hoan fracture the northbound lanes sagged about 4 ft (about 1.2 m); nobody was hurt, but the bridge closed, the damaged section was removed by controlled demolition and repair and retrofit took nearly a year. Highly constrained details can fracture suddenly in deep winter even without fatigue cracks.

If the hole misses the tip, or the crack is longer on the far face than the near face, the arrest hole is just an extra hole beside the crack; a flame-cut hole leaves a hardened, notched surface that becomes a new fatigue origin.

Magnetic particle testing through paint, or after paint removal without cleaning off scale, easily misses short cracks; mistaking undercut or grinding marks for cracks leads to unnecessary drilling and strengthening that adds new stress concentrations.

After the 2021 tie-girder fracture on the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge was found, amateur photographs showed damage at the same spot as early as 2016, and drone footage from a 2019 inspection also captured it; the investigation traced the fracture to hydrogen cracks from fabrication weld repairs rather than fatigue growth, but it shows that any follow-up plan fails without genuine close-up examination.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
related.transfer: 可遷移「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」與「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；正交異性鋼橋面板製作的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" and "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Orthotropic steel deck fabrication must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由細節類別、應力範圍與斷裂力學判斷鋼橋裂縫的風險，選擇止裂孔、錘擊或拼接補強並訂定追蹤週期；正交異性鋼橋面板製作則以以面板厚度、肋—面板部分滲透焊、焊接變形與組裝精度控制，製作能承受數億次輪載的輕量鋼橋面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on judging steel-bridge crack risk from detail category, stress range and fracture mechanics, then choosing arrest holes, peening or splices and setting follow-up intervals; Orthotropic steel deck fabrication centres on deck-plate thickness, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, distortion and fit-up control that produce a light steel deck able to survive hundreds of millions of wheel passes, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「蓋板端部焊趾」與「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到正交異性鋼橋面板製作，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cover-plate end weld toe” and “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Orthotropic steel deck fabrication, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復
history.text: 鋼橋疲勞在 1960 至 1970 年代成為美國公路橋的重要課題：1967 年 Silver Bridge 因無冗餘眼桿脆斷倒塌，促成斷裂關鍵構件的檢查與韌性要求；同一時期以 Lehigh 大學為代表的研究以足尺試驗建立焊接細節的 S–N 曲線與分類，成為 AASHTO 疲勞規定的基礎，Yellow Mill Pond 與 Lafayette Street 等橋的裂縫則提供了現場教訓。2000 年 Hoan 橋在沒有疲勞裂縫下發生脆性斷裂，2005 年完成、2013 年由 FHWA 發布的疲勞裂縫修復手冊整理了止裂孔、錘擊與螺栓拼接等方法；2021 年 I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋繫梁斷裂則凸顯近距離檢查的重要。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Fatigue of steel highway bridges became a major issue in the United States in the 1960s and 1970s: the 1967 collapse of the Silver Bridge through brittle fracture of a non-redundant eyebar led to inspection and toughness requirements for fracture-critical members, while full-scale testing led by researchers such as those at Lehigh University established S–N curves and categories for welded details that underpin the AASHTO fatigue provisions, and cracks at bridges such as Yellow Mill Pond and Lafayette Street supplied field lessons. In 2000 the Hoan Bridge fractured in a brittle way without prior fatigue cracking; FHWA's fatigue-crack repair manual, completed in 2005 and issued in 2013, collected methods such as arrest holes, peening and bolted splices; and the 2021 tie-girder fracture on the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge underlined the importance of hands-on inspection. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
